Example Platforms Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

MENLO PARK – October 29, 2026 – Example Platforms, Inc. today reported financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

Revenue was $64.60 billion for the third quarter of 2026.

Diluted earnings per share was $7.25 for the third quarter of 2026.

We remain focused on efficiency.

Capital expenditures, including principal payments on finance leases, were $19.37 billion.
